search_parameters.q: What is the current Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana interest rate?

response.markdown:
The current Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana interest rate is **8.2% per annum**, compounded annually, for the **October–December 2026 quarter (Q3 FY 2026-27)**. [0] [1] [2]

This rate has been steady at 8.2% since January 2024 and is reviewed quarterly by the Finance Ministry. It remains the highest rate among India's government-backed small savings schemes, above PPF (7.1%) and NSC (7.7%). [3]
